sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: This is Christopher Cox.
sentences.zh: 我是克里斯托弗·考克斯。

sentences.en: I'm a contributor to The New York Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报杂志》的撰稿人。

sentences.en: And this week's Sunday read features a recent story of mine about Elon Musk and Tesla.
sentences.zh: 本周的“周日阅读”栏目刊登了我最近关于埃隆·马斯克和特斯拉的一篇报道。

sentences.en: So Tesla is facing a difficult few months.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉正面临艰难的几个月。

sentences.en: As I speak, five separate lawsuits against Musk's electric car company are set to go to trial for crashes involving Autopilot, one of its self-driving products.
sentences.zh: 就在我说话的同时，针对马斯克旗下电动汽车公司的五起独立诉讼即将开庭审理，这些案件都涉及其自动驾驶产品之一——Autopilot引发的车祸。

sentences.en: In four of those cases, the crashes were fatal.
sentences.zh: 其中四起案件导致了人员死亡。

sentences.en: I've been tracking these lawsuits for about a year now.
sentences.zh: 我追踪这些诉讼已经大约一年了。

sentences.en: And in the beginning, I was mainly interested in the ethical questions raised by self-driving technology.
sentences.zh: 起初，我主要关注的是自动驾驶技术引发的伦理问题。

sentences.en: How do we assign blame when a computer is involved in a car crash?
sentences.zh: 当计算机卷入车祸时，我们该如何界定责任？

sentences.en: As I learned more about Autopilot and Tesla's full self-driving program, I discovered that there's a more basic question that hasn't yet been answered.
sentences.zh: 随着我对Autopilot和特斯拉“全自动驾驶”项目的深入了解，我发现还有一个更基本的问题尚未得到解答。

sentences.en: Are these cars actually ready for the road?
sentences.zh: 这些车真的准备好上路了吗？

sentences.en: I went on test drives with Tesla owners who were convinced the answer is yes.
sentences.zh: 我随特斯拉车主进行了试驾，他们坚信答案是肯定的。

sentences.en: But then, their cars nearly steered themselves into serious crashes while I was in the passenger seat.
sentences.zh: 但当我坐在副驾驶座上时，他们的车却差点自动驶入严重的撞车事故中。

sentences.en: Recently, Tesla announced that it was recalling more than 360,000 vehicles because of problems with its full self-driving system.
sentences.zh: 最近，特斯拉宣布召回超过36万辆汽车，原因是其全自动驾驶系统存在问题。

sentences.en: Eventually, I realized that the key to understanding Tesla's headlong pursuit of self-driving and
sentences.zh: 最终，我意识到理解特斯拉对自动驾驶的盲目追求以及

sentences.en: the resulting court cases could be found in Elon Musk's personal philosophy of risk, which
sentences.zh: 由此引发的法律诉讼的关键，在于埃隆·马斯克个人的风险哲学，

sentences.en: he has revealed in his public statements and in previously unpublished correspondence that I uncovered.
sentences.zh: 这一点在他公开的声明以及我所挖掘出的此前未发表的通信中都有所体现。

sentences.en: The good news is that Musk seems to be motivated by an earnest desire to save lives.
sentences.zh: 好消息是，马斯克似乎是出于拯救生命的真诚愿望而受到驱动。

sentences.en: But whether the experiment he's running on our roads and highways will produce that outcome, that remains an open question.
sentences.zh: 但他正在我们的道路和高速公路上进行的实验是否会产生那样的结果，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。

sentences.en: So here's my article, Elon Musk's Appetite for Destruction, read by James Patrick Cronin.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的文章《埃隆·马斯克的毁灭欲望》，由詹姆斯·帕特里克·克罗宁朗读。
zh_words: 詹姆斯·帕特里克·克罗宁朗

sentences.en: This was recorded by Autumn.
sentences.zh: 这是由Autumn录制的。

sentences.en: To listen to more stories from The New York Times, The New Yorker, Vanity Fair, The Atlantic,
sentences.zh: 想要在智能手机上收听更多来自《纽约时报》、《纽约客》、《名利场》、《大西洋月刊》

sentences.en: and other publications on your smartphone, download Autumn on the App Store or the Play Store.
sentences.zh: 以及其他出版物的故事，请在App Store或Play Store下载Autumn。

sentences.en: Visit Autumn, that's A-U-D-M dot com, for more details.
sentences.zh: 访问Autumn，即A-U-D-M点com，了解更多详情。

sentences.en: Early on, the software had the regrettable habit of hitting police cruisers.
sentences.zh: 早期，该软件有一个令人遗憾的习惯，就是会撞上警车。

sentences.en: No one knew why, though Tesla's engineers had some good guesses.
sentences.zh: 没人知道原因，尽管特斯拉的工程师们有一些合理的猜测。

sentences.en: Stationary objects and flashing lights seemed to trick the AI.
sentences.zh: 静止的物体和闪烁的灯光似乎欺骗了人工智能。

sentences.en: The car would be driving along normally, the computer well in control, and suddenly it would veer to the right or left and smash, at least ten times in just over three years.
sentences.zh: 汽车本在正常行驶，计算机控制得很好，突然它就会向右或向左猛打方向盘并发生碰撞，在短短三年多时间里至少发生了十次。

sentences.en: For a company that depended on an unbounded sense of optimism among investors to maintain its high stock price.
sentences.zh: 对于一家依赖投资者无限乐观情绪来维持高股价的公司而言，

sentences.en: Tesla was, at one point, worth more than Toyota, Honda, Volkswagen, Mercedes,
sentences.zh: 特斯拉一度的市值超过了丰田、本田、大众、梅赛德斯、

sentences.en: BMW, Ford, and General Motors combined.
sentences.zh: 宝马、福特和通用汽车的总和。

sentences.en: These crashes might seem like a problem.
sentences.zh: 这些撞车事故看起来可能是一个问题。

sentences.en: But to Elon Musk, Tesla's chief executive, they presented an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 但对特斯拉首席执行官埃隆·马斯克来说，它们提供了一个机会。

sentences.en: Each collision generated data, and with enough data, the company could speed the development of the world's first truly self-driving car.
sentences.zh: 每一次碰撞都会产生数据，只要有足够的数据，公司就能加速开发世界上第一辆真正意义上的自动驾驶汽车。

sentences.en: He believed in this vision so strongly that it led him to make wild predictions.
sentences.zh: 他坚信这一愿景，以至于做出了疯狂的预测。

sentences.en: My guess as to when we would think it is safe for somebody to essentially fall asleep and wake up at their destination, probably toward the end of next year, Musk said in 2019.
sentences.zh: 马斯克在2019年说：“关于我们何时会认为一个人基本上可以睡着觉醒来就到达目的地是安全的，我的猜测可能是明年年底。”

sentences.en: I would say I am certain of that.
sentences.zh: “我会说我对此很确定。”

sentences.en: That is not a question mark.
sentences.zh: “这不是一个疑问。”

sentences.en: The future of Tesla may rest on whether drivers knew that they were engaged in this data-gathering experiment, and if so, whether their appetite for risk matched Musk's.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉的未来可能取决于驾驶员是否知道他们参与了这项数据收集实验，如果是，他们的风险偏好是否与马斯克相符。

sentences.en: I wanted to hear from the victims of some of the more minor accidents, but they tended to fall into two categories, neither of which predisposed them to talk.
sentences.zh: 我曾想听听一些较小事故受害者的说法，但他们往往分为两类，而这两类人都不愿开口。

sentences.en: They either loved Tesla and Musk and didn't want to say anything negative to the press, or they were suing the company and remaining silent on the advice of counsel.
sentences.zh: 他们要么热爱特斯拉和马斯克，不想对媒体说任何负面的话；要么正在起诉该公司，并在律师的建议下保持沉默。

sentences.en: Umair Ali, whose Tesla steered into a highway barrier in 2017, had a different excuse.
sentences.zh: 乌迈尔·阿里，他的特斯拉在2017年撞上了高速公路护栏，他给出了不同的借口。

sentences.en: Put me down as declined interview because I don't want to piss off the richest man in the world.
sentences.zh: “把我的名字记作拒绝采访，因为我不想惹恼世界上最富有的人。”

sentences.en: Then I found Dave Key.
sentences.zh: 后来我找到了戴夫·基。

sentences.en: On May 29th, 2018, Key's 2015 Tesla Model S was driving him home from the dentist in autopilot mode.
sentences.zh: 2018年5月29日，基的2015款特斯拉Model S在自动驾驶模式下送他从牙医诊所回家。

sentences.en: It was a route that Key had followed countless times before.
sentences.zh: 那是基走过无数次的路线。

sentences.en: A two-lane highway leading up into the hills above Laguna Beach, California.
sentences.zh: 一条通往加利福尼亚州拉古纳海滩上方山丘的双车道公路。

sentences.en: But on this trip, while Key was distracted, the car drifted out of its lane and slammed into the back of a parked
sentences.zh: 但在这次行程中，当基分心时，车偏离了车道，猛地撞上了一辆停在路边的

sentences.en: police SUV, spinning the car around and pushing the SUV up onto the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 警用SUV，导致车身旋转，并将SUV推上了人行道。

sentences.en: No one was hurt.
sentences.zh: 没有人受伤。

sentences.en: Key, a 69-year-old former software entrepreneur, took a dispassionate engineer's eye view of his own accident.
sentences.zh: 基，一位69岁的前软件企业家，以冷静的工程师视角看待自己的事故。

sentences.en: The problem with stationary objects—I'm sorry, this sounds stupid—is that they don't move, he said.
sentences.zh: “静止物体的问题在于——抱歉，这听起来很蠢——它们不会动，”他说。

sentences.en: For years, Tesla's artificial intelligence had trouble separating immobile objects from the background.
sentences.zh: 多年来，特斯拉的人工智能一直难以将静止物体与背景区分开来。

sentences.en: Rather than feeling frustrated that the computer hadn't figured out such a seemingly
sentences.zh: 基并没有因为计算机没能解决这样一个看似

sentences.en: elementary problem, Key took comfort in learning that there was a reason behind the crash—a known software limitation, rather than some kind of black swan event.
sentences.zh: 基础的问题而感到沮丧，反而因为得知撞车背后是有原因的而感到宽慰——那是一个已知的软件局限性，而不是某种黑天鹅事件。

sentences.en: Last fall, I asked Key to visit the scene of the accident with me.
sentences.zh: 去年秋天，我请基和我一起重回事故现场。

sentences.en: He said he would do me one better.
sentences.zh: 他说他会做得更好。

sentences.en: He would take me there using Tesla's new full self-driving mode, which was still in beta.
sentences.zh: 他要用特斯拉当时仍处于测试阶段的全新全自动驾驶模式带我去那里。

sentences.en: I told Key that I was surprised he was still driving a Tesla, much less paying extra—FSD now costs $15,000—for new autonomous features.
sentences.zh: 我告诉基，我很惊讶他还在开特斯拉，更不用说额外花钱——FSD现在要1.5万美元——去买新的自动驾驶功能了。

sentences.en: If my car had tried to kill me, I would have switched brands.
sentences.zh: 如果我的车曾试图杀了我，我会换个品牌。

sentences.en: But in the months and years after his Model S was totaled, he bought three more.
sentences.zh: 但在他的Model S报废后的几个月和几年里，他又买了三辆。

sentences.en: We met for breakfast at a cafe in Laguna Beach, about three miles from the crash site.
sentences.zh: 我们在拉古纳海滩的一家咖啡馆吃早餐，距离事故现场约三英里。

sentences.en: Key was wearing a black V-neck T-shirt, khaki shorts, and sandals.
sentences.zh: 基穿着一件黑色V领T恤、卡其色短裤和凉鞋。

sentences.en: Southern California semi-retirement chic.
sentences.zh: 南加州半退休风格。

sentences.en: As we walked to our table, he locked the doors of his red 2022 Model S, and the side mirrors folded up like a dog's ears when it's being petted.
sentences.zh: 当我们走向餐桌时，他锁上了他那辆红色的2022款Model S，侧后视镜像狗被抚摸时那样折叠起来。

sentences.en: Key had brought along a four-page memo he drafted for our interview, listing facts about the accident, organized under subheadings like Tesla Full
sentences.zh: 基随身带了一份他为我们的采访起草的四页备忘录，列出了关于事故的事实，并按小标题组织，如“特斯拉全

sentences.en: Self-Driving Technology Discussion.
sentences.zh: 自动驾驶技术讨论”。

sentences.en: He's the sort of man who walks around with a battery of fully formed opinions on life's most important subjects—computers, software, exercise, money, and a
sentences.zh: 他属于那种随身带着一套关于生活中最重要议题——计算机、软件、锻炼、金钱——的成熟观点，并且

sentences.en: willingness to share them.
sentences.zh: 乐于分享的人。

sentences.en: He was particularly concerned that I understand that Autopilot and
sentences.zh: 他特别关心我是否理解Autopilot和

sentences.en: FSD were saving lives.
sentences.zh: FSD正在拯救生命。

sentences.en: The data shows that their accident rate while on beta is far less than other cars, one bullet point read in 11-point Calibri.
sentences.zh: “数据显示，它们在测试期间的事故率远低于其他汽车，”一份用11号Calibri字体打印的要点写道。

sentences.en: Slowing down the FSD beta will result in more accidents and loss of life based on hard statistical data.
sentences.zh: “减缓FSD测试将导致更多的事故和生命损失，这是基于硬性统计数据的。”

sentences.en: Accidents like his, and even the deadly ones, are unfortunate, he argued, but they couldn't distract society from the larger goal of widespread adoption of autonomous vehicles.
sentences.zh: 他认为，像他这样的事故，甚至是致命的事故，都是不幸的，但不能让社会偏离广泛采用自动驾驶汽车这一更大的目标。

sentences.en: Key drew an analogy to the coronavirus vaccines, which prevented hundreds of thousands of deaths but also caused rare deaths and injuries from adverse reactions.
sentences.zh: 基将此比作新冠疫苗，它预防了数十万人的死亡，但也因不良反应导致了罕见的死亡和伤害。

sentences.en: As a society, he concluded, we choose the path to save the most lives.
sentences.zh: 他总结道，作为一个社会，我们选择了拯救最多生命的道路。

sentences.en: We finished breakfast and walked to the car.
sentences.zh: 我们吃完早餐，走向车子。

sentences.en: Key had hoped to show off the newest version of FSD, but his system hadn't updated yet.
sentences.zh: 基曾希望展示最新版本的FSD，但他的系统还没有更新。

sentences.en: Elon said it would be released at the end of the week, he said.
sentences.zh: “埃隆说它会在周末发布，”他说。

sentences.en: Well, it's Sunday.
sentences.zh: “嗯，今天是周日。”

sentences.en: Musk had been hinting for weeks that the update would be a drastic improvement over FSD 10.13, which had been released over the summer.
sentences.zh: 马斯克几周来一直暗示，这次更新将比夏季发布的FSD 10.13有巨大的改进。

sentences.en: Because Musk liked to make little jokes out of the names and numbers in his life, the version number would jump to 10.69 with this release.
sentences.zh: 因为马斯克喜欢在他生活中的名字和数字里开点小玩笑，所以这次发布的版本号会跳到10.69。

sentences.en: The four available Tesla models are S, 3, X, and Y, presumably because that spells the word sexy.
sentences.zh: 现有的四款特斯拉车型分别是S、3、X和Y，大概是因为这拼起来是“性感”（sexy）这个词。

sentences.en: Key didn't want to talk about Musk, but the executives' reputational collapse had become impossible to ignore.
sentences.zh: 基不想谈论马斯克，但这位高管的声誉崩溃已经让人无法忽视。

sentences.en: He was in the middle of his bizarre, on-again, off-again campaign to take over Twitter, to the dismay of Tesla loyalists.
sentences.zh: 他正处于那场令人费解、反反复复的收购推特的行动中，令特斯拉的忠实拥护者们感到沮丧。

sentences.en: And though he hadn't yet attacked Anthony Fauci or spread conspiracy theories about Nancy Pelosi's husband or gone on a journalist banning spree on the
sentences.zh: 虽然他当时还没有攻击安东尼·福奇，也没有在

sentences.en: platform, the question was already suggesting itself.
sentences.zh: 平台上散布关于南希·佩洛西丈夫的阴谋论，也没有开始封禁记者的狂潮，但这个问题已经呼之欲出。

sentences.en: How do you explain Elon Musk?
sentences.zh: 你该如何解释埃隆·马斯克？

sentences.en: People are flawed, Key said cautiously, before repeating a sentiment that Musk often said about himself.
sentences.zh: “人都是有缺陷的，”基谨慎地说，随后重复了马斯克常对自己说的一句话。

sentences.en: If partisans on both sides hated him, he must be doing something right.
sentences.zh: 如果双方的党派人士都讨厌他，那他一定做对了什么。

sentences.en: No matter what trouble Musk got himself into, Key said, he was honest, truthful to his detriment.
sentences.zh: 基说，无论马斯克陷入什么麻烦，他都是诚实的，甚至诚实到损害自己的利益。

sentences.en: As we drove, Key compared FSD and the version of Autopilot on his 2015 Tesla.
sentences.zh: 开车时，基比较了FSD和他2015款特斯拉上的Autopilot版本。

sentences.en: Autopilot, he said, was like fancy cruise control.
sentences.zh: 他说，Autopilot就像高级巡航控制。

sentences.en: Speed, steering, crash avoidance.
sentences.zh: 速度、转向、防撞。

sentences.en: Though in his case, he said, I guess it didn't do crash avoidance.
sentences.zh: “虽然就我的情况而言，”他说，“我想它没能做到防撞。”

sentences.en: He had been far more impressed by FSD.
sentences.zh: 他对FSD印象深刻得多。

sentences.en: It was able to handle just about any situation he threw at it.
sentences.zh: 它几乎能处理他抛给它的任何情况。

sentences.en: My only real complaint is it doesn't always select the lane that I would.
sentences.zh: “我唯一的真正抱怨是它并不总是选择我想要的车道。”

sentences.en: After a minute, the car warned Key to keep his hands on the wheel and eyes on the road.
sentences.zh: 一分钟后，汽车警告基要保持双手放在方向盘上，眼睛注视路面。

sentences.en: Tesla now is kind of a nanny about that, he complained.
sentences.zh: “特斯拉现在在这方面有点像个保姆，”他抱怨道。

sentences.en: If Autopilot was once dangerously permissive of inattentive drivers, allowing them to nod off behind the wheel even, that flaw, like the stationary object bug, had been fixed.
sentences.zh: 如果说Autopilot曾经对不专心的驾驶员过于宽容，甚至允许他们在方向盘后打瞌睡，那么那个缺陷，就像静止物体漏洞一样，已经被修复了。

sentences.en: Between the steering wheel and the eye tracking, that's just a solved problem, Key said.
sentences.zh: “在方向盘和眼球追踪之间，这已经是一个解决的问题了，”基说。

sentences.en: Soon, we were close to the scene of the crash.
sentences.zh: 很快，我们接近了事故现场。

sentences.en: Scrub-covered hills with mountain biking trails lacing through them rose on either side of us.
sentences.zh: 覆盖着灌木丛的山丘，山地自行车道穿插其中，在我们两侧升起。

sentences.en: That was what got Key into trouble on the day of the accident.
sentences.zh: 那就是事故当天让基陷入麻烦的原因。

sentences.en: He was looking at a favorite trail and ignoring the road.
sentences.zh: 他当时正看着一条喜欢的步道，而忽略了路面。

sentences.en: I looked up to the left and the car went off to the right, he said.
sentences.zh: “我抬头看向左边，车就向右偏了，”他说。

sentences.en: I was in this false sense of security.
sentences.zh: “我当时有一种虚假的安全感。”

sentences.en: We parked at the spot where he hit the police SUV four years earlier.
sentences.zh: 我们停在他四年前撞上警用SUV的地方。

sentences.en: There was nothing special about the road here.
sentences.zh: 这里的路没什么特别的。

sentences.en: No strange lines, no confusing lane shift, no merge.
sentences.zh: 没有奇怪的标线，没有令人困惑的车道变换，没有汇入。

sentences.en: Just a single lane of traffic running along a row of parked cars.
sentences.zh: 只有一条车道沿着一排停放的汽车延伸。

sentences.en: Why the Tesla failed at that moment was a mystery.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉为何在那一刻失灵，仍是一个谜。

sentences.en: Eventually, Key told FSD to take us back to the cafe.
sentences.zh: 最终，基让FSD带我们回咖啡馆。

sentences.en: As we started our left turn, though, the steering wheel spasmed and the brake pedal juddered.
sentences.zh: 然而，当我们开始左转时，方向盘抽动了一下，刹车踏板也震动起来。

sentences.en: Key muttered a nervous, okay.
sentences.zh: 基紧张地嘟囔了一句：“好吧。”

sentences.en: After another moment, the car pulled halfway across the road and stopped.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，车开到路中间停了下来。

sentences.en: A line of cars was bearing down on our broadside.
sentences.zh: 一排车正朝我们的侧面冲过来。

sentences.en: Key hesitated a second but then quickly took over and completed the turn.
sentences.zh: 基犹豫了一秒，但随后迅速接管并完成了转弯。

sentences.en: It probably could have then accelerated but I wasn't willing to cut it that close, he said.
sentences.zh: “它本可以加速的，但我不想冒那么大的险，”他说。

sentences.en: If he was wrong, of course, there was a good chance that he would have had his second AI-caused accident on the same one-mile stretch of road.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果他判断错了，他很有可能在同一英里长的路段上发生第二次由人工智能引发的事故。

sentences.en: Three weeks before Key hit the police SUV, Musk wrote an email to Jim Riley, whose son Barrett died after his Tesla crashed while speeding.
sentences.zh: 在基撞上警用SUV的三周前，马斯克给吉姆·莱利写了一封邮件，莱利的儿子巴雷特在特斯拉超速撞车后身亡。

sentences.en: Musk sent Riley his condolences and the grieving father wrote back to ask whether Tesla's software could be updated to allow an owner to set a maximum speed
sentences.zh: 马斯克向莱利表示哀悼，这位悲痛的父亲回信询问特斯拉的软件是否可以更新，允许车主设置最高速度

sentences.en: for the car, along with other restrictions on acceleration, access to the radio and the trunk, and distance the car could drive from home.
sentences.zh: 以及对加速、收音机和后备箱的使用权限，以及汽车离家距离的其他限制。

sentences.en: Musk, while sympathetic, replied,
sentences.zh: 马斯克虽然表示同情，但回复道：

sentences.en: If there are a large number of settings, it will be too complex for most people to use.
sentences.zh: “如果设置太多，对大多数人来说会太复杂。”

sentences.en: I want to make sure that we get this right.
sentences.zh: “我想确保我们把这件事做对。”

sentences.en: Most good for most number of people.
sentences.zh: “为最多的人带来最大的利益。”

sentences.en: It was a stark demonstration of what makes Musk so unusual as a chief executive.
sentences.zh: 这鲜明地展示了马斯克作为首席执行官的独特之处。

sentences.en: First, he reached out directly to someone who was harmed by one of his products, something it's hard to imagine the head of GM or Ford contemplating, if only for legal reasons.
sentences.zh: 首先，他直接联系了被他产品伤害的人，这很难想象是通用或福特的老板会考虑的事，即便只是出于法律原因。

sentences.en: Indeed, this email was entered into evidence after Riley sued Tesla.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这封邮件在莱利起诉特斯拉后被作为证据提交。

sentences.en: And then Musk rebuffed Riley.
sentences.zh: 然后，马斯克拒绝了莱利。

sentences.en: No vague, I'll look into it or we'll see what we can do.
sentences.zh: 没有含糊的“我会考虑”或“我们会看看能做什么”。

sentences.en: Riley receives a hard no.
sentences.zh: 莱利收到的是明确的拒绝。

sentences.en: Like Key, I want to resist Musk's tendency to make every story about him.
sentences.zh: 像基一样，我想抵制马斯克那种把每个故事都变成关于他自己的倾向。

sentences.en: Tesla is a big car company with thousands of employees.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉是一家拥有数千名员工的大型汽车公司。

sentences.en: It existed before Elon Musk.
sentences.zh: 它在埃隆·马斯克之前就存在了。

sentences.en: It might exist after Elon Musk.
sentences.zh: 它在埃隆·马斯克之后可能还会存在。

sentences.en: But if you want a parsimonious explanation for the challenges the company faces, in the form of the lawsuits, a crashing stock price,
sentences.zh: 但如果你想用一个简洁的解释来概括这家公司面临的挑战，比如那些诉讼、暴跌的股价，

sentences.en: and an AI that still seems all too capable of catastrophic failure, you should look to its mercurial, brilliant, sophomoric chief executive.
sentences.zh: 以及那套似乎仍极易引发灾难性故障的人工智能，你就应该去看看它那位反复无常、才华横溢却又显得有些幼稚的首席执行官。

sentences.en: Perhaps there's no mystery here.
sentences.zh: 或许这根本没什么神秘的。

sentences.en: Musk is simply a narcissist, and every reckless swerve he makes is meant solely to draw the world's attention.
sentences.zh: 马斯克不过是个自恋者，他每一次鲁莽的转向，目的都只是为了吸引全世界的目光。

sentences.en: He seemed to endorse this theory in a tongue-in-cheek way during a recent deposition, when a lawyer asked him,
sentences.zh: 在最近的一次证词陈述中，他似乎以一种半开玩笑的方式认可了这一理论，当时一位律师问他：

sentences.en: Do you have some kind of unique ability to identify narcissistic sociopaths?
sentences.zh: “你是否有某种识别自恋型反社会人格者的独特能力？”

sentences.en: And he replied,
sentences.zh: 他回答道：

sentences.en: You mean by looking in the mirror?
sentences.zh: “你是说照镜子吗？”

sentences.en: But what looks like self-obsession and poor impulse control might instead be the fruits of a coherent philosophy, one that Musk has detailed on many occasions.
sentences.zh: 但那些看起来像是自我沉迷和冲动控制力差的表现，或许其实是一套连贯哲学的结果，马斯克曾在多个场合详细阐述过这套哲学。

sentences.en: It's there in the email to Riley.
sentences.zh: 在那封给莱利的邮件里就提到了。

sentences.en: The greatest good for the greatest number of people.
sentences.zh: 为尽可能多的人谋求尽可能大的利益。

sentences.en: That dictum, as part of an ad hoc system of utilitarian ethics, can explain all sorts of mystifying decisions that Musk has made, not least his breakneck pursuit of AI,
sentences.zh: 作为一种临时功利主义伦理体系的一部分，这句格言可以解释马斯克所做的各种令人费解的决定，尤其是他那对人工智能的疯狂追求，

sentences.en: which in the long term he believes will save countless lives.
sentences.zh: 他相信从长远来看，这能拯救无数生命。

sentences.en: Unfortunately for Musk, the short term comes first, and his company faces a rough few months.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，对马斯克来说，短期利益优先，而他的公司正面临几个艰难的月份。

sentences.en: In February, the first lawsuit against Tesla for a crash involving autopilot will go to trial.
sentences.zh: 二月份，首起针对特斯拉自动驾驶仪（Autopilot）事故的诉讼案将开庭审理。

sentences.en: Four more will follow in quick succession.
sentences.zh: 随后还将紧接着进行四起诉讼。

sentences.en: Donald Slavik, who will represent plaintiffs in as many as three of those cases, says that a normal car company would have settled by now.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·斯拉维克（Donald Slavik）将代表其中多达三起案件的原告，他说，一家正常的汽车公司早就应该达成和解了。

sentences.en: They look at it as a cost of doing business.
sentences.zh: 他们会把这视为经营成本。

sentences.en: Musk has vowed to fight it out in court, no matter the dangers this might present for Tesla.
sentences.zh: 但马斯克誓言要与对方在法庭上抗争到底，无论这可能给特斯拉带来什么风险。

sentences.en: The dollars can add up, Slavik said,
sentences.zh: “赔偿金可能会越积越多，”斯拉维克说。

sentences.en: Slavik sent me one of the complaints he filed against Tesla, which lists prominent autopilot crashes from A to Z.
sentences.zh: 斯拉维克给我发了一份他针对特斯拉提起的诉状，上面列出了从A到Z的著名自动驾驶事故。

sentences.en: In fact, from A to WW.
sentences.zh: 事实上，是从A到WW。

sentences.en: In China, a Tesla slammed into the back of a street sweeper.
sentences.zh: 在中国，一辆特斯拉撞上了一辆清扫车的尾部。

sentences.en: In Florida, a Tesla hit a tractor trailer that was stretched across two lanes of a highway.
sentences.zh: 在佛罗里达州，一辆特斯拉撞上了一辆横跨高速公路两条车道的牵引挂车。

sentences.en: During a downpour in Indiana, a Tesla Model 3 hydroplaned off the road and burst into flames.
sentences.zh: 在印第安纳州的一场暴雨中，一辆特斯拉Model 3发生水滑，冲出路面并起火燃烧。

sentences.en: In the Florida Keys, a Model S drove through an intersection and killed a pedestrian.
sentences.zh: 在佛罗里达群岛，一辆Model S穿过十字路口时撞死了一名行人。

sentences.en: In New York, a Model Y struck a man who was changing his tire on the shoulder of the Long Island Expressway.
sentences.zh: 在纽约，一辆Model Y撞上了一名正在长岛高速公路路肩上换轮胎的男子。

sentences.en: In Montana, a Tesla steered unexpectedly into a highway barrier.
sentences.zh: 在蒙大拿州，一辆特斯拉意外地驶向了高速公路护栏。

sentences.en: Then the same thing happened in Dallas, and in Mountain View, and in San Jose.
sentences.zh: 随后，同样的事情又在达拉斯、山景城和圣何塞发生了。

sentences.en: The arrival of self-driving vehicles wasn't meant to be like this.
sentences.zh: 自动驾驶汽车的到来本不该是这样的。

sentences.en: Day in, day out, we scare and maim and kill ourselves in cars.
sentences.zh: 日复一日，我们在车里制造恐惧、残疾和死亡。

sentences.en: In the United States last year, there were around 11 million road accidents, nearly 5 million injuries, and more than 40,000 deaths.
sentences.zh: 去年在美国，大约发生了1100万起道路交通事故，造成近500万人受伤，超过4万人死亡。

sentences.en: Tesla's AI was meant to put an end to this bloodbath.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉的人工智能本应终结这场血腥屠杀。

sentences.en: Instead, on average, there is at least one autopilot-related crash in the United States every day,
sentences.zh: 然而，平均每天在美国至少会发生一起与自动驾驶仪相关的事故，

sentences.en: and Tesla is under investigation by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.
sentences.zh: 而且特斯拉正受到美国国家公路交通安全管理局的调查。

sentences.en: Ever since Autopilot was released in October 2015,
sentences.zh: 自2015年10月自动驾驶仪发布以来，

sentences.en: Musk has encouraged drivers to think of it as more advanced than it was, stating in January 2016 that it was probably better than a human driver.
sentences.zh: 马斯克一直鼓励驾驶员将其视为比实际更先进的技术，并在2016年1月声称它可能比人类驾驶员更好。

sentences.en: That November, the company released a video of a Tesla navigating the roads of the Bay Area with the disclaimer,
sentences.zh: 那年11月，该公司发布了一段特斯拉在湾区道路上行驶的视频，并附带了免责声明：

sentences.en: The person in the driver's seat is only there for legal reasons.
sentences.zh: “驾驶座上的人仅出于法律原因坐在那里。”

sentences.en: He is not doing anything.
sentences.zh: “他什么也没做。”

sentences.en: The car is driving itself.
sentences.zh: “汽车在自动驾驶。”

sentences.en: Musk also rejected the name Copilot in favor of Autopilot.
sentences.zh: 马斯克还拒绝了“副驾驶”（Copilot）这个名字，而选择了“自动驾驶仪”（Autopilot）。

sentences.en: The fine print made clear that the technology was for driver assistance only, but that message received a fraction of the attention of Musk's announcements.
sentences.zh: 细则中明确指出该技术仅用于驾驶辅助，但这一信息所获得的关注度远不及马斯克的公告。

sentences.en: A large number of drivers seemed genuinely confused about Autopilot's capabilities.
sentences.zh: 许多驾驶员似乎对自动驾驶仪的功能感到真正的困惑。

sentences.en: Tesla also declined to disclose that the car in the 2016 video crashed in the company's parking lot.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉还拒绝透露2016年视频中的那辆车其实在公司停车场撞过车。

sentences.en: Slavic's legal complaint doesn't hold back.
sentences.zh: 斯拉维克的法律诉状毫不留情。

sentences.en: Tesla's conduct was despicable and so contemptible that it would be looked down upon and despised by ordinary, decent people.
sentences.zh: “特斯拉的行为卑劣且令人不齿，普通正派人士都会对此感到鄙夷和唾弃。”

sentences.en: The many claims of the pending lawsuits come back to a single theme.
sentences.zh: 这些悬而未决的诉讼中的许多指控都指向同一个主题。

sentences.en: Tesla consistently inflated consumer expectations and played down the dangers involved.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉一贯夸大消费者的期望，并淡化其中涉及的危险。

sentences.en: The cars didn't have sufficient driver monitoring because Musk didn't want drivers to think that the car needed human supervision.
sentences.zh: 这些车没有足够的驾驶员监控，因为马斯克不想让驾驶员认为汽车需要人类监督。

sentences.en: Musk, in April 2019,
sentences.zh: 马斯克在2019年4月曾说：

sentences.en: If you have a system that's at or below human-level reliability, then driver monitoring makes sense.
sentences.zh: “如果你拥有的系统可靠性处于或低于人类水平，那么驾驶员监控是有意义的。”

sentences.en: But if your system is dramatically better, more reliable than a human, then monitoring does not help much.
sentences.zh: “但如果你的系统明显更好、比人类更可靠，那么监控就没有多大帮助了。”

sentences.en: Drivers weren't warned about problems with automatic braking or uncommanded lane changes.
sentences.zh: 驾驶员没有收到关于自动刹车或未经指令变道问题的警告。

sentences.en: The company would admit to the technology's limitations in the user manual, but publish viral videos of a Tesla driving a complicated route with no human intervention.
sentences.zh: 公司会在用户手册中承认该技术的局限性，但却发布病毒式传播的视频，展示特斯拉在无人干预的情况下行驶在复杂的路线上。

sentences.en: Musk's ideal customer was someone like Key, willing to accept the blame when something went wrong, but possessing almost limitless faith in the next update.
sentences.zh: 马斯克的理想客户是像凯（Key）那样的人，愿意在出错时承担责任，但对下一次更新却拥有近乎无限的信心。

sentences.en: In a deposition, an engineer at Tesla made this all but explicit.
sentences.zh: 在一次证词陈述中，特斯拉的一名工程师几乎明确了这一点。

sentences.en: We want to let the customer know that, number one, you should have confidence in your vehicle.
sentences.zh: “我们想让客户知道，第一，你应该对你的车辆有信心。”

sentences.en: Everything is working just as it should.
sentences.zh: “一切都在按预期工作。”

sentences.en: And, secondly, the reason for your accident or reason for your incident always falls back on you.
sentences.zh: “第二，你发生事故或事件的原因总是归咎于你自己。”

sentences.en: After our failed left turn in Laguna Beach, Key quickly diagnosed the problem.
sentences.zh: 在我们在拉古纳海滩那次失败的左转之后，凯很快就诊断出了问题所在。

sentences.en: If only the system had upgraded to FSD 10.69, he argued, the car surely would have managed the turn safely.
sentences.zh: 他认为，如果系统升级到了FSD 10.69版本，车肯定能安全完成转弯。

sentences.en: Unfortunately for Musk, not every Tesla owner is like Dave Key.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，对马斯克来说，并非每一位特斯拉车主都像戴夫·凯（Dave Key）那样。

sentences.en: The plaintiffs in the autopilot lawsuits might agree that the AI is improving, but only on the backs of the early adopters and bystanders who might be killed along the way.
sentences.zh: 自动驾驶仪诉讼案的原告们或许会同意人工智能正在进步，但这却是以早期采用者和沿途可能被撞死的路人为代价的。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温纳卢（Winnalou）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“连接”（Connections）谜题，我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天负责创作“拼字蜜蜂”（Spelling Bee）和“字母盒”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”（promesthesia）的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Line, there's a battle between pro-Musk and anti-Musk factions about autopilot and FSD.
sentences.zh: 关于自动驾驶仪和FSD，支持马斯克和反对马斯克的阵营之间存在着一场争斗。

sentences.en: Reddit has a forum called R Real Tesla that showcases the most embarrassing AI screw-ups, along with more generic complaints.
sentences.zh: Reddit上有一个名为“R Real Tesla”的论坛，展示了最令人尴尬的人工智能失误，以及更多常见的投诉。

sentences.en: Squeaky steering wheels, leaky roofs, haywire electronics, noisy cabins, stiff suspensions, wrinkled leather seats, broken door handles.
sentences.zh: 吱吱作响的方向盘、漏水的车顶、失控的电子设备、嘈杂的车厢、僵硬的悬挂、起皱的真皮座椅、损坏的门把手。

sentences.en: The Musk stans tend to sequester themselves in R Tesla Motors, where they post Tesla sightings,
sentences.zh: 马斯克的死忠粉倾向于聚集在“R Tesla Motors”论坛，在那里他们发布特斯拉的目击记录，

sentences.en: cheer on the company's latest factory openings, and await the next big announcement from the boss.
sentences.zh: 为公司最新的工厂开业欢呼，并等待老板的下一个重大公告。

sentences.en: I found David Alford on YouTube, where he posted a video called
sentences.zh: 我在YouTube上发现了大卫·阿尔福德（David Alford），他发布了一个名为

sentences.en: Tesla Full Self-Driving Running a Red Light.
sentences.zh: “特斯拉全自动驾驶闯红灯”的视频。

sentences.en: In it, we see the view through the windshield as Alford's car approaches an intersection with a left turn lane that has a dedicated traffic signal.
sentences.zh: 在视频中，我们透过挡风玻璃看到阿尔福德的车正接近一个十字路口，那里有一条带有专用交通信号灯的左转车道。

sentences.en: With a few hundred yards remaining, the light shifts from green to red.
sentences.zh: 在距离还有几百码时，信号灯从绿色变成了红色。

sentences.en: But the car doesn't stop.
sentences.zh: 但车并没有停下来。

sentences.en: Instead, it rolls into the intersection, where it's on track to collide with oncoming traffic, until Alford takes over.
sentences.zh: 相反，它滑进了十字路口，眼看就要与迎面而来的车辆相撞，直到阿尔福德接管了控制权。

sentences.en: In the comments, Tesla fans grow angry with Alford for posting the video, but he pushes back.
sentences.zh: 在评论区，特斯拉粉丝对阿尔福德发布视频感到愤怒，但他进行了反驳。

sentences.en: How does it help put pressure on Tesla to improve their systems if you are scared to post their faults?
sentences.zh: “如果你不敢发布特斯拉的故障，那怎么能给他们施加压力去改进系统呢？”

sentences.en: Replying to one comment, he writes that FSD is unethical in the context they are using it.
sentences.zh: 他在回复一条评论时写道，在他们使用FSD的环境下，使用它是违背道德的。

sentences.en: When I called Alford, I was expecting someone suited for our real Tesla, but he ended up having more of an our Tesla Motors vibe.
sentences.zh: 当我给阿尔福德打电话时，我本以为他会是那种适合“R Real Tesla”的人，但结果他反而更有一种“R Tesla Motors”的氛围。

sentences.en: He told me that he would be willing to take me to the site of his video and demonstrate the failure, but first I had to make a promise.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他愿意带我去他视频中的那个地点演示故障，但首先我必须答应一个条件。

sentences.en: The only thing I ask is try not to put me in a bad light toward Tesla, he said.
sentences.zh: “我唯一的要求是尽量不要让我显得对特斯拉不利，”他说。

sentences.en: I don't want anybody to think that I hate the company or whatnot, because I'm a very, very big supporter of them.
sentences.zh: “我不希望任何人认为我讨厌这家公司什么的，因为我是他们非常、非常大的支持者。”

sentences.en: Alford lives in Fresno, California, and before I went to meet him one day last fall, he told me some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 阿尔福德住在加利福尼亚州的弗雷斯诺，去年秋天有一天我去见他之前，他告诉了我一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: He had just received the FSD 10.69 update.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚收到了FSD 10.69的更新。

sentences.en: Our drive would be his first attempt to navigate the intersection from the YouTube video with the new system.
sentences.zh: 我们的驾驶将是他使用新系统导航YouTube视频中那个十字路口的首次尝试。

sentences.en: The morning I met him, he was wearing a black t-shirt that showed off his tattoos, black sunglasses, and faded black jeans with holes in the knees.
sentences.zh: 我见到他的那天早上，他穿着一件展示着纹身的黑色T恤，戴着黑色太阳镜，穿着膝盖处磨损的黑色牛仔裤。

sentences.en: Hollywood would typecast him as a white hat hacker, and indeed he's a software guy like he.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞会把他定型为“白帽黑客”，事实上，他确实像他一样是个软件工程师。

sentences.en: He is a product engineer for a Bay Area tech company.
sentences.zh: 他是湾区一家科技公司的产品工程师。

sentences.en: His white 2020 Tesla Model 3 had a magnetic bumper sticker he found on Etsy.
sentences.zh: 他那辆白色的2020款特斯拉Model 3上贴着一个他在Etsy上买的磁性保险杠贴纸。

sentences.en: Caution, full self-driving testing in progress.
sentences.zh: “小心，全自动驾驶测试进行中。”

sentences.en: He said he drives in FSD mode 90% of the time, so his car is always acting a bit strange.
sentences.zh: 他说他90%的时间都在用FSD模式驾驶，所以他的车总是表现得有点奇怪。

sentences.en: The sticker helped keep some of the honking from other cars at bay.
sentences.zh: 这张贴纸有助于减少其他车辆的鸣笛声。

sentences.en: He seemed to be, like Key, an ideal FSD beta tester.
sentences.zh: 他似乎和凯一样，是一位理想的FSD内测员。

sentences.en: Interested in the software, alert to its flaws, dogged in his accumulation of autonomous miles.
sentences.zh: 对软件感兴趣，对缺陷保持警觉，在积累自动驾驶里程方面锲而不舍。

sentences.en: I climbed into the passenger seat and Alford punched in our first destination, a spot a few blocks away in downtown Fresno.
sentences.zh: 我爬进副驾驶座，阿尔福德输入了我们的第一个目的地，弗雷斯诺市中心几个街区外的一个地方。

sentences.en: We were lucky it was overcast, he said, because the car behaved well in these conditions.
sentences.zh: 他说，很幸运今天阴天，因为车在这种条件下表现良好。

sentences.en: On days when it was sunny out and there was a lot of glare, the car could be moody.
sentences.zh: 在阳光明媚、眩光严重的日子里，车可能会变得喜怒无常。

sentences.en: And when it was foggy, and it was often foggy in Fresno, it freaks out.
sentences.zh: 而当有雾的时候——弗雷斯诺经常有雾——它就会惊慌失措。

sentences.en: After a few minutes, we approached a crosswalk, just as two parents pulling a child in a wagon began to cross.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，我们接近一个人行横道，正好有两个家长拉着一个坐在小车里的孩子开始过马路。

sentences.en: A screen next to the steering wheel showed that the AI had registered the two pedestrians, but not the wagon.
sentences.zh: 方向盘旁边的屏幕显示人工智能已经识别出了那两名行人，但没有识别出小车。

sentences.en: Alford said he was hovering his foot over the brake, but the car stopped on its own.
sentences.zh: 阿尔福德说他的脚一直悬在刹车上，但车自己停了下来。

sentences.en: After the wagon came a woman in a wheelchair.
sentences.zh: 小车过后，是一位坐轮椅的女士。

sentences.en: The car stayed put.
sentences.zh: 车停在原地没动。

sentences.en: Alford told me that the automotive jargon for anyone on the street who is not in a car or a truck is a VRU, a vulnerable road user.
sentences.zh: 阿尔福德告诉我，汽车行业对街上任何不在汽车或卡车里的人的术语是VRU，即弱势道路使用者。

sentences.en: And it's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Pedestrians and cyclists and children in strollers and women in wheelchairs,
sentences.zh: 行人和骑自行车的人、坐在婴儿车里的孩子和坐轮椅的女士，

sentences.en: they are so fragile compared with these giant machines we've stuffed into our cities and onto our highways.
sentences.zh: 与我们塞进城市和高速公路上的这些庞大机器相比，他们是如此脆弱。

sentences.en: One wrong move, and a car will crush them.
sentences.zh: 一个错误的动作，车就会碾压他们。

sentences.en: We turned onto Van S Avenue, which cuts through downtown.
sentences.zh: 我们转到了穿过市中心的范内斯大道（Van S Avenue）。

sentences.en: It had been newly paved, and instead of lines on the street, there were little yellow tabs indicating where the lines would eventually go.
sentences.zh: 它刚铺好路，街上没有划线，只有一些黄色的小标签指示着未来划线的位置。

sentences.en: The Tesla hated this and dodged wordedly right and left, looking for something to anchor it.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉讨厌这个，它左右摇摆，寻找可以锚定的东西。

sentences.en: There were no other cars around, so Alford let it get that out of its system and eventually find a lane line to follow.
sentences.zh: 周围没有其他车，所以阿尔福德让它把这股劲儿发泄出来，最终找到了一条车道线来跟随。

sentences.en: You build a tolerance to the risks it takes, he said.
sentences.zh: “你对它冒的风险产生了一种耐受力，”他说。

sentences.en: Yes, it's swerving all over the place, but I know it's not going to crash into something.
sentences.zh: “是的，它在到处乱晃，但我知道它不会撞到什么东西。”

sentences.en: Still, the experience of the Beta had changed the way he approached his own work.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，内测的经历改变了他对待自己工作的方式。

sentences.en: It's actually made me, as a software developer, more hesitant to put my software in the hands of people before it's fully ready, he said, even though it's not dangerous.
sentences.zh: “作为一名软件开发人员，这实际上让我更犹豫是否要在软件完全准备好之前就将其交到人们手中，”他说，“即使它并不危险。”

sentences.en: Seconds later, we drove through an intersection as two VRUs, a man walking a dog, entered the crosswalk.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟后，我们穿过一个十字路口，这时两个VRU——一个遛狗的男人——进入了人行横道。

sentences.en: They were a safe distance away, but the dog started to strain against its leash in our direction.
sentences.zh: 他们距离很安全，但那只狗开始朝着我们的方向拉扯牵引绳。

sentences.en: Alford and I knew that the pet wasn't in peril because the leash would stop it, but all the Tesla saw was a dog about to jump in front of us, and it came to an abrupt stop.
sentences.zh: 阿尔福德和我都知道宠物没有危险，因为牵引绳会拦住它，但特斯拉看到的只是狗要跳到我们面前，于是它猛地停了下来。

sentences.en: It was a good outcome, all things considered, no injuries to any life form, but it was far from a seamless, self-driving experience.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，这是一个好的结果，没有任何生命受到伤害，但这远非一次顺畅的自动驾驶体验。

sentences.en: Alford nudged the steering wheel just often enough that the car never warned him to pay attention.
sentences.zh: 阿尔福德轻推方向盘的频率恰到好处，以至于车从未警告他要集中注意力。

sentences.en: He didn't mind the strict driver monitoring.
sentences.zh: 他不介意严格的驾驶员监控。

sentences.en: He never tired of studying the car's behavior, so he was never tempted to tune out.
sentences.zh: 他从不厌倦研究汽车的行为，所以他从未想过要分心。

sentences.en: Still, he knew people who abused the system.
sentences.zh: 不过，他认识一些滥用该系统的人。

sentences.en: One driver tied an ankle weight to the steering wheel to kick back and do whatever during long road trips.
sentences.zh: 一名驾驶员在方向盘上绑了一个踝部配重，以便在长途旅行中放松并做任何事情。

sentences.en: I know a couple of people with Teslas that have FSD beta, he said, and they have it to drink and drive instead of having to call an Uber.
sentences.zh: “我认识几个有特斯拉并使用FSD内测版的人，”他说，“他们用它来酒后驾驶，而不是叫优步。”

sentences.en: We left downtown and got on the highway, headed toward an area northeast of the city called Clovis, where the tricky intersection was.
sentences.zh: 我们离开了市中心，上了高速公路，前往城市东北部一个叫克洛维斯（Clovis）的地方，那个棘手的十字路口就在那里。

sentences.en: Alford pulled up his FSD settings.
sentences.zh: 阿尔福德调出了他的FSD设置。

sentences.en: His default driver mode was average, but he said he has found that the two other options, chill and assertive, aren't much different.
sentences.zh: 他的默认驾驶模式是“平均”，但他表示他发现另外两个选项——“冷静”和“果断”——并没有太大区别。

sentences.en: The car is just really aggressive anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正这车本来就非常激进。

sentences.en: For highway driving, though, he had the car set to something called Mad Max mode, which meant it would overtake any vehicle in front of him
sentences.zh: 不过，对于高速公路驾驶，他把车设置成了所谓的“疯狂麦克斯”（Mad Max）模式，这意味着它会超掉他前面的任何车辆，

sentences.en: if it was going even a few miles per hour slower than his preferred speed.
sentences.zh: 只要对方的速度比他预设的速度慢哪怕几英里每小时。

sentences.en: We exited the highway and quickly came to a knot of cars.
sentences.zh: 我们驶出高速公路，很快遇到了一团拥挤的车辆。

sentences.en: Something had gone wrong with the traffic light, which was flashing red, and drivers in all four directions, across eight lanes, had to figure out when to go and when to yield.
sentences.zh: 交通灯出了故障，一直在闪烁红灯，四个方向、八条车道的驾驶员都必须自己判断何时通行、何时让行。

sentences.en: The choreography here was delicate.
sentences.zh: 这里的编排很微妙。

sentences.en: There were too many cars to interweave without some allowances being made for mercy and confusion and expediency.
sentences.zh: 车太多了，如果不做出一些宽容、困惑和权宜之计的让步，就无法交织通行。

sentences.en: Among the humans, there was a good deal of waving others on and attempted eye contact to see whether someone was going to yield or not.
sentences.zh: 在人类驾驶员之间，有很多挥手示意和试图通过眼神交流来判断对方是否会让行。

sentences.en: We crept toward the intersection, car by car, until it was our turn.
sentences.zh: 我们一辆接一辆地向十字路口蠕动，直到轮到我们。

sentences.en: If we were expecting nuance, there was none.
sentences.zh: 如果我们期待的是细微差别，那这里根本没有。

sentences.en: Once we had come to a complete stop, the Tesla accelerated quickly, cutting off one car turning across us and veering around another.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们完全停下，特斯拉就迅速加速，切断了一辆横向转弯的车，并绕过了另一辆车。

sentences.en: It was not so much inhuman as the behavior of a human who was determined to be a jerk.
sentences.zh: 与其说它不近人情，不如说它的行为就像一个一心想当混蛋的人。

sentences.en: That was bad, Alfred said.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德说，那太糟糕了。

sentences.en: Normally, I would disengage once it makes a mistake like that.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，一旦它犯了那样的错误，我就会解除自动驾驶。

sentences.en: He clicked a button to send a snapshot of the incident to Tesla.
sentences.zh: 他点了一下按钮，将事故快照发送给了特斯拉。

sentences.en: Later, at a four-way stop, the car was too cautious.
sentences.zh: 后来，在一个四向停车路口，这辆车表现得过于谨慎。

sentences.en: It waited too long, and the other two cars at the intersection drove off before we did.
sentences.zh: 它等待的时间太长了，路口另外两辆车在我们之前就开走了。

sentences.en: We talked about the old saying about safe driving, don't be nice, be predictable.
sentences.zh: 我们谈到了那句关于安全驾驶的老话：不要做个好人，要做个可预测的人。

sentences.en: For a computer, Tesla's AI was surprisingly erratic.
sentences.zh: 对于一台计算机来说，特斯拉的人工智能表现得令人惊讶地不稳定。

sentences.en: It's not nice or predictable, Alfred said.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德说，它既不好也不可预测。

sentences.en: A few miles down the road, we reached the intersection from the video, a left turn onto East Shepard Avenue from State Route 168.
sentences.zh: 在几英里外的路上，我们到达了视频中的那个路口，那是从168号国道左转进入东谢泼德大道的路口。

sentences.en: The traffic light sits right at the point where the city's newest developments end and open land begins.
sentences.zh: 红绿灯正好位于城市最新开发区结束和开阔地带开始的交界处。

sentences.en: If we drove straight, we would immediately find ourselves surrounded by sagebrush on the way up into the Sierra.
sentences.zh: 如果我们直行，很快就会发现自己被周围的灌木丛包围，正前往内华达山脉。

sentences.en: To replicate the error that Alfred uncovered, we needed to approach the intersection with a red left turn arrow and a green light to continue straight.
sentences.zh: 为了复现阿尔弗雷德发现的错误，我们需要在左转红灯亮起、直行绿灯亮起时接近该路口。

sentences.en: On our first pass, the arrow turned green at the last second.
sentences.zh: 我们第一次经过时，左转箭头在最后一秒变绿了。

sentences.en: On the second pass, though, on an empty road, the timing was right.
sentences.zh: 不过在第二次经过时，路上空无一人，时机恰到好处。

sentences.en: A red for our turn and green for everyone else.
sentences.zh: 我们这边是红灯，而其他人是绿灯。

sentences.en: As we got closer, the car moved into the turning lane and started to slow.
sentences.zh: 当我们靠近时，车子驶入了转弯车道并开始减速。

sentences.en: It sees the red, I said.
sentences.zh: 我说，它看到红灯了。

sentences.en: No, Alfred said.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德说，不。

sentences.en: It always slows down a little here before plowing through.
sentences.zh: 它每次在这里都会减速一点，然后直接冲过去。

sentences.en: But this time, it kept slowing.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，它一直在减速。

sentences.en: Alfred couldn't believe it.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: It's still going to run the light, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，它还是要闯红灯。

sentences.en: But he was wrong.
sentences.zh: 但他错了。

sentences.en: We came to a tidy stop right at the line.
sentences.zh: 我们在停车线前稳稳地停了下来。

sentences.en: Alfred was shocked.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德感到震惊。

sentences.en: They fixed it, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，他们修好了。

sentences.en: That one I've been giving them an issue about for two years.
sentences.zh: 这个问题我已经向他们反馈两年了。

sentences.en: We waited patiently until the light turned green and the Tesla drove smoothly onto Shepard Avenue.
sentences.zh: 我们耐心地等到绿灯亮起，特斯拉平稳地驶入了谢泼德大道。

sentences.en: No problem.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: It was as clear a demonstration of Musk's hypothesis as one could hope for.
sentences.zh: 这正如人们所期望的那样，清晰地证明了马斯克的假设。

sentences.en: There was a situation that kept stumping the AI until, after enough data had been collected by dedicated drivers like Alfred,
sentences.zh: 曾经有一个问题一直困扰着人工智能，直到像阿尔弗雷德这样敬业的司机收集了足够的数据，

sentences.en: Alfred, the neural net figured it out.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德，神经网络终于搞定了。

sentences.en: Repeat this risk-reward conversion X number of times, and maybe Tesla will solve self-driving.
sentences.zh: 重复这种风险与回报的转换X次，也许特斯拉就能解决自动驾驶问题。

sentences.en: Maybe even next year.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能就在明年。

sentences.en: On the drive back to the center of Fresno,
sentences.zh: 在回弗雷斯诺市中心的路上，

sentences.en: Alfred was buoyant, delighted with the possibility that he had changed the Tesla world for the better.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德心情愉悦，为自己可能让特斯拉的世界变得更好而感到高兴。

sentences.en: I asked him whether the FSD 10.69 release met the hype that preceded it.
sentences.zh: 我问他FSD 10.69版本的发布是否达到了之前的炒作预期。

sentences.en: To be honest, yeah, I think so, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，老实说，是的，我认为达到了。

sentences.en: He was even more enthusiastic about the version of FSD released in December, which he described as nearly flawless.
sentences.zh: 他对12月发布的FSD版本更加热情，称其几乎完美无瑕。

sentences.en: A few minutes later, we reached a run-down part of town.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，我们到达了城里一个破旧的地方。

sentences.en: Alfred said that in general,
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德说，总的来说，

sentences.en: Tesla's AI does better in higher-income areas, maybe because those areas have more Tesla owners in them.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉的人工智能在高收入地区表现更好，也许是因为这些地区有更多的特斯拉车主。

sentences.en: Are there data biases for higher-income areas because that's where the Teslas are?
sentences.zh: 是因为特斯拉都在高收入地区，所以数据对这些地区存在偏见吗？

sentences.en: He wondered.
sentences.zh: 他纳闷道。

sentences.en: We approached an intersection and tried to make a left, in what turned out to be a repeat of the Laguna Beach scenario.
sentences.zh: 我们接近一个路口并试图左转，结果发现这又是拉古纳海滩场景的重演。

sentences.en: The Tesla started creeping out, trying to get a clearer look at the cars coming from our left.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉开始缓慢前行，试图更清楚地观察从我们左侧驶来的车辆。

sentences.en: It inched forward, inched forward, until once again we were fully in the lane of traffic.
sentences.zh: 它一点一点地向前挪动，直到我们再次完全处于车流之中。

sentences.en: There was nothing stopping the Tesla from accelerating and completing the turn, but instead it just sat there.
sentences.zh: 当时没有任何东西阻碍特斯拉加速完成转弯，但它只是停在那里。

sentences.en: At the same time, a tricked-out Honda Accords sped toward us, about three seconds away from hitting the driver's side door.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一辆改装过的本田雅阁向我们疾驰而来，距离撞上驾驶座侧门仅剩约三秒钟。

sentences.en: Alfred quickly took over and punched the accelerator, and we escaped safely.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德迅速接管并猛踩油门，我们安全逃脱了。

sentences.en: This time, he didn't say anything.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他什么也没说。

sentences.en: It was a rough ride home from there.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，回家的路程变得很艰难。

sentences.en: At a standard left turn at a traffic light, the system freaked out and tried to go right.
sentences.zh: 在一个标准的红绿灯左转路口，系统突然失控，试图向右转。

sentences.en: Alfred had to take over.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德不得不接管车辆。

sentences.en: Right now in San Francisco and Austin, Texas, and coming soon to cities all over the world, you can hail a robo-taxi operated by Cruise or Waymo.
sentences.zh: 现在在旧金山和德克萨斯州的奥斯汀，而且很快就会在世界各地的城市，你可以叫到一辆由 Cruise 或 Waymo 运营的无人驾驶出租车。

sentences.en: If there's one moment in time where we go from fiction to reality, it's now, Sebastian Thrun, who founded Google's self-driving car team, told me.
sentences.zh: 谷歌自动驾驶汽车团队的创始人塞巴斯蒂安·特龙告诉我，如果说有一个时刻我们从虚构走向了现实，那就是现在。

sentences.en: I didn't say this last year, by the way, he added.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我去年没这么说，他补充道。

sentences.en: Thrun was no our real Tesla lurker.
sentences.zh: 特龙并不是我们那种真正的特斯拉潜伏者。

sentences.en: He was on his fifth Tesla, and he said he admired the company.
sentences.zh: 他已经是第五次开特斯拉了，他说他很欣赏这家公司。

sentences.en: What Tesla has is really beautiful.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉拥有的东西真的很美。

sentences.en: They have a fleet of vehicles in the field.
sentences.zh: 他们有一支在实地运行的车队。

sentences.en: But at this point,
sentences.zh: 但在这一点上，

sentences.en: Tesla's competitors are closer to achieving full self-driving than any vehicle equipped with FSD.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉的竞争对手比任何配备 FSD 的车辆都更接近实现完全自动驾驶。

sentences.en: In recent months, Musk has stopped promising that autonomous Teslas are just around the corner.
sentences.zh: 近几个月来，马斯克不再承诺自动驾驶特斯拉指日可待。

sentences.en: I thought the self-driving problem would be hard, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，我原以为自动驾驶问题会很难。

sentences.en: But it was harder than I thought.
sentences.zh: 但它比我想象的还要难。

sentences.en: It's not like I thought it'd be easy.
sentences.zh: 并不是说我以为它会很容易。

sentences.en: I thought it would be very hard.
sentences.zh: 我以为它会非常难。

sentences.en: But it was actually way harder than even that.
sentences.zh: 但实际上它比那还要难得多。

sentences.en: On December 29th, 2019, the same day a Tesla in Indiana got into a deadly crash with a parked fire truck, an off-duty chauffeur named Kevin George Aziz Riyad
sentences.zh: 2019 年 12 月 29 日，就在印第安纳州一辆特斯拉与一辆停着的消防车发生致命碰撞的同一天，一位名叫凯文·乔治·阿齐兹·里亚德的休班司机
zh_words: 凯文·乔治·阿齐兹·里亚德

sentences.en: was driving his gray 2016 Tesla Model S down the Gardena Freeway in suburban Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 正驾驶着他那辆灰色的 2016 款特斯拉 Model S 在洛杉矶郊区的加迪纳高速公路上行驶。

sentences.en: It had been a long drive back from a visit to Orange County, and Riyad had autopilot turned on.
sentences.zh: 从奥兰治县回来是一段漫长的车程，里亚德开启了自动驾驶辅助系统。

sentences.en: Shortly after midnight, the car passed under a giant sign that said,
sentences.zh: 午夜过后不久，汽车经过了一个巨大的标志牌，上面写着：

sentences.en: End Freeway Signal Ahead, in flashing yellow lights.
sentences.zh: 前方高速公路终点信号，闪烁着黄灯。

sentences.en: The autopilot kept Riyad's Tesla at a steady speed as it approached the stoplight that marked the end of the freeway and the beginning of Artesia Boulevard.
sentences.zh: 当汽车接近标志着高速公路结束和阿特西亚大道开始的红绿灯时，自动驾驶辅助系统让里亚德的特斯拉保持着稳定的速度。

sentences.en: According to a witness, the light was red, but the car drove straight through the intersection, striking a Honda Civic.
sentences.zh: 据目击者称，当时是红灯，但汽车径直穿过了十字路口，撞上了一辆本田思域。

sentences.en: Riyad had only minor injuries, but the two people in the Civic,
sentences.zh: 里亚德只受了轻伤，但思域车里的两个人，

sentences.en: Gilberto Alcazar Lopez and Maria Guadalupe Nieves, died at the scene.
sentences.zh: 吉尔伯托·阿尔卡萨尔·洛佩兹和玛丽亚·瓜达卢佩·涅维斯，当场死亡。
zh_words: 吉尔伯托·阿尔卡萨尔·洛佩兹

sentences.en: Their families said that they were on a first date.
sentences.zh: 他们的家人说他们当时正在进行第一次约会。

sentences.en: Who was responsible for this accident?
sentences.zh: 谁该为这次事故负责？

sentences.en: State officials have charged Riyad with manslaughter and planned to prosecute him as if he were the sole actor behind the two deaths.
sentences.zh: 州政府官员已指控里亚德犯有过失杀人罪，并计划起诉他，就好像他是造成这两起死亡事件的唯一责任人一样。

sentences.en: The victims' families, meanwhile, have filed civil suits against both Riyad and Tesla.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，受害者的家人已对里亚德和特斯拉提起了民事诉讼。

sentences.en: Depending on the outcomes of the criminal and civil cases, the autopilot system could be judged, in effect, legally responsible, not legally responsible, or both simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 根据刑事和民事案件的结果，自动驾驶系统实际上可能被判定为负有法律责任、不负有法律责任，或两者同时存在。

sentences.en: Not long ago, I went to see the spot where Riyad's Tesla reportedly ran the red light.
sentences.zh: 不久前，我去看了一下里亚德的特斯拉据称闯红灯的那个地点。

sentences.en: I had rented a Tesla for the day to find out firsthand, finally, what it felt like to drive with autopilot in control.
sentences.zh: 我租了一辆特斯拉开了一天，想亲身体验一下在自动驾驶辅助系统控制下开车是什么感觉。

sentences.en: I drove east on surface streets until I reached a ramp where I could merge onto State Route 91, the Gardena Freeway.
sentences.zh: 我沿着地面道路向东行驶，直到到达一个匝道，在那里我可以汇入 91 号州道，即加迪纳高速公路。

sentences.en: It was late at night when Riyad crashed.
sentences.zh: 里亚德出事时是在深夜。

sentences.en: I was taking my ride in the middle of the day.
sentences.zh: 我是在白天开车。

sentences.en: As soon as I was on the highway, I engaged autopilot, and the car took over.
sentences.zh: 我一上高速公路就开启了自动驾驶辅助系统，汽车就接管了控制权。

sentences.en: I had the road mostly to myself.
sentences.zh: 路上几乎只有我一辆车。

sentences.en: This Tesla was programmed to go 15% above the speed limit whenever autopilot was in use, and the car accelerated quickly to 74 miles per hour,
sentences.zh: 这辆特斯拉被设定为在自动驾驶辅助系统开启时以超过限速 15% 的速度行驶，汽车迅速加速到每小时 74 英里，

sentences.en: which was Riyad's speed when he crashed.
sentences.zh: 这正是里亚德撞车时的速度。

sentences.en: Were his autopilot speed settings the same?
sentences.zh: 他的自动驾驶辅助系统速度设置也是一样的吗？

sentences.en: The car did a good job of staying in its lane, better than any other traffic-aware cruise control I've used.
sentences.zh: 这辆车在保持车道方面做得很好，比我用过的任何其他交通感知巡航控制系统都要好。

sentences.en: I tried taking my hands off the wheel, but the Tesla beeped at me after a few seconds.
sentences.zh: 我试着把手从方向盘上移开，但几秒钟后特斯拉就对我发出了蜂鸣声。

sentences.en: As I got closer to the crash site, I passed under the giant
sentences.zh: 当我靠近事故现场时，我经过了那个巨大的

sentences.en: End Freeway Signal Ahead sign.
sentences.zh: 前方高速公路终点信号标志。

sentences.en: The autopilot drove on blithely.
sentences.zh: 自动驾驶辅助系统若无其事地继续行驶。

sentences.en: After another 500 feet, the same sign appeared again, flashing urgently.
sentences.zh: 又过了 500 英尺，同样的标志再次出现，闪烁着紧急信号。

sentences.en: There was only a few hundred feet of divided highway left, and then Route 91 turned into a surface street right at the intersection with Vermont Avenue.
sentences.zh: 只剩下几百英尺的分隔高速公路了，然后 91 号公路就在与佛蒙特大道的十字路口处变成了地面道路。

sentences.en: I hovered my foot over the brake.
sentences.zh: 我的脚悬在刹车上。

sentences.en: What was I doing?
sentences.zh: 我在做什么？

sentences.en: Seeing if the car truly would just blaze through a red light?
sentences.zh: 看看这辆车是否真的会直接冲过红灯？

sentences.en: Of course it would.
sentences.zh: 它当然会。

sentences.en: I suppose I was trying to imagine how easy it would be to do such a thing.
sentences.zh: 我想我是在试图想象做这种事有多容易。

sentences.en: At the end of a long night, on a road empty of cars, with something called autopilot in control?
sentences.zh: 在一个漫漫长夜的尽头，在一条空无一车的路上，在所谓的自动驾驶辅助系统的控制下？

sentences.en: My guess is that Riyadh didn't even notice that he had left the highway.
sentences.zh: 我猜里亚德甚至没有注意到他已经离开了高速公路。

sentences.en: The car sped under the warning lights
sentences.zh: 汽车在警示灯下疾驰而过，

sentences.en: 74 miles an hour.
sentences.zh: 时速 74 英里。

sentences.en: The crash data shows that before the Tesla hit Lopez and Nieves, the brakes hadn't been used for six minutes.
sentences.zh: 碰撞数据显示，在特斯拉撞上洛佩兹和涅维斯之前，刹车已经有六分钟没有使用过了。

sentences.en: My Tesla bore down on the intersection.
sentences.zh: 我的特斯拉冲向了十字路口。

sentences.en: I got closer and closer to the light.
sentences.zh: 我离红绿灯越来越近。

sentences.en: No brakes.
sentences.zh: 没有刹车。

sentences.en: And then, just before I was about to take over, a pickup truck swung out of the far right lane and cut me off.
sentences.zh: 然后，就在我准备接管控制权之前，一辆皮卡车从最右侧车道猛地冲出来，切到了我前面。

sentences.en: The Tesla sensed it immediately and braked hard.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉立刻感应到了，并猛踩刹车。

sentences.en: If only that truck, as undeniable as any giant chunk of hardware can be, had been there in December 2019.
sentences.zh: 如果那辆卡车——像任何巨大的硬件块一样不可否认——在 2019 年 12 月也在那里就好了。

sentences.en: Lopez and Nieves would still be alive.
sentences.zh: 洛佩兹和涅维斯现在还活着。

sentences.en: For decades,
sentences.zh: 几十年来，

sentences.en: the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me,
sentences.zh: 在我和我主持的《Metro》最新一期节目中，

sentences.en: Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·凯尼格，讲述了人们试图维持自己的影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
